Maya Lin: hi everyone, day 1! quick question: if I run into a permissions error pushing a model to Dedicated or hit production inference slowness, who should I ping? also where's the compact org list of owners?

Rafael Ortiz: welcome Maya! :wave: Short flow -> perms: access form (link below) and tag @june or @rafael. Dedicated provisioning/quota -> platform-ops ticket with label `dedicated-request` and mention @rafael for triage.

June Park: for production incidents always post in #eng-oncall first so the bot can page. If customer-facing latency spike -> `!pager` and call the on-call PD number. For VPC/KMS stuff, open a security ticket and tag @security-eng.

Samir Patel: escalation quick-guide: P0 = outage or >50% errors or sustained p99 >2x SLO for >10m -> page immediately and start incident. P1 = serious degradation (partial region or p99 1.5-2x SLO) -> notify on-call and open incident within 15m. P2 = single-customer or non-prod issues -> ticket. See runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/incident-escalation

Maya Lin: awesome, sensible. where's the one-page owner map?

Rafael Ortiz: owners matrix (one-pager) -> https://redwood.internal/handbook/owners-quickmap.pdf. If you want, @june can send a pinned copy in #new-hires.

eng-oncall-bot: Current on-call: Samir Patel (week 1934550000). To page: post in #eng-oncall with `!pager` or use PagerDuty UI.

June Park: i'll ping the one-pager into #new-hires and DM you the access form link. welcome aboard! :tada:
